strings: Zenn Foulhoof is a satyr lingering just east of Dolanaar in Teldrassil. He approaches passersby with requests for forest reagents, while the local night elves keep a close eye on him.

Unlike most satyrs, who are outright hostiles serving demonic masters, Zenn Foulhoof somehow secured a tenuous tolerance just outside Dolanaar. He maintains a friendly facade, claiming he has changed or wants to trade in harmless forest reagents like nightsaber fangs, strigid owl feathers, and webwood spider silk. In reality, he manipulates gullible youths to procure ingredients for foul rituals. Dolanaar's council refuses to let him operate unchecked; rather than executing him immediately, they order adventurers to humiliate him by feeding him corrupted forest fruit, temporarily transforming the scheming satyr into a harmless frog.
Why isn't Zenn Foulhoof immediately attacked by the night elves?

Zenn maintains a friendly veneer and has not yet openly committed atrocities on the World Tree, leading the council of Dolanaar to discipline him through public humiliation and watchfulness rather than an immediate death sentence.

What happens when you feed Zenn the corrupted cones and berries?
The elders of Dolanaar order this as penance for Zenn's misdeeds. The result of the punishment is revealed when he eats the corrupted fruit.

Satyrs are night elves who were warped into horned, cloven-hoofed fiends during the War of the Ancients after pledging service to the Burning Legion. Most are utterly corrupted and violently hostile to their uncorrupted kin.
corrupted cone | dolanaar | satyr | seek redemption | teldrassil | zenn foulhoof
Zenn's tampering with wild reagents and deliberate spreading of corrupting taints directly offends Cenarion teachings, which seek to keep Teldrassil pristine.
Satyrs represent the ultimate betrayal of kaldorei heritage. Seeing one lounging on the sacred boughs of Teldrassil is an insult to Elune and the spirits of the wild.

Zevrost is an orc warlock trainer secluded within the subterranean Cleft of Shadow beneath Orgrimmar. He mentors developing warlocks of the Horde, guiding them through the hazardous disciplines of fel magic, summoning rituals, and binding dark artifacts.

Tucked away deep in the caverns of the Cleft of Shadow, Zevrost is one of the principal mentors for Horde warlocks residing in Thrall's capital. While the broader orcish society remains wary of fel energies following the demonic corruption of their past, practitioners like Zevrost are tolerated under strict watch. He instills in his pupils the harsh discipline required to command demonic forces without succumbing to their corruptive nature, asserting that the fel only ruins those lacking inner strength.

Beyond basic instruction in spells and curses, Zevrost acts as a conduit for more ambitious dark undertakings. Initiates seeking advanced implements—such as the Orb of Orahil or the means to summon a fiery Felsteed—frequently pass through his hands. He directs aspirational practitioners to other masters of the craft, such as Menara Voidrender in the Barrens, ensuring that those who wield shadow magic push their capabilities to their absolute limits.
Zevrost is an orc warlock trainer stationed in the Cleft of Shadow beneath Orgrimmar. He teaches novice and experienced Horde warlocks new incantations and guides them on pivotal class rituals.
zevrost role | who is zevrost | zevrost npc
He resides in the subterranean cavern known as the Cleft of Shadow, located beneath the main districts of Orgrimmar.
zevrost location | where is zevrost | find zevrost
Why are warlocks like Zevrost permitted in Orgrimmar?

While Thrall's Horde strictly regulates and monitors dark sorcery due to the orcs' history with demon blood, warlocks are permitted to practice in the secluded depths of the Cleft of Shadow to provide valuable, ruthless power against the Horde's many enemies.
why are warlocks allowed in orgrimmar | warlock cleft of shadow
What is Zevrost's philosophy on demonic magic?

Zevrost believes that dark and arcane energies only corrupt those who are weak of will. He urges his students to maintain rigid discipline in their studies lest they succumb to the destructive forces they command.
cleft of shadow | fel magic | felsteed | orgrimmar | trainer | warlock | zevrost
For Horde warlocks, Zevrost is a vital instructor, unlocking advanced spells and setting initiates on quests to secure specialized weapons, off-hands, and their fiery steed.
Living among an orcish society that largely shuns demonic magic, Zevrost represents those practitioners who still harness dark arts under the heavy scrutiny of the Warchief.

Zjolnir is a Darkspear troll mount breeder stationed in Sen'jin Village along the southern coast of Durotar. He provides trained riding raptors to the Darkspear and trustworthy champions of the Horde. For troll riders, his stable of vicious, loyal beasts is a point of deep cultural pride.

Situated near the pens of Sen'jin Village, Zjolnir tends to the fierce raptors favored as mounts by the Darkspear trolls. Raptors are temperamental and predatory by nature, requiring an expert hand to raise and saddle for war. Zjolnir freely provides these prized whistled mounts to fellow trolls who have learned the necessary riding arts. Outsiders belonging to the wider Horde must first earn the exalted trust of the Darkspear tribe before Zjolnir will consider trusting them with one of his pack.
Zjolnir is located in Sen'jin Village, a coastal Darkspear settlement found in the southern reaches of Durotar, standing beside the village's raptor pens.
zjolnir location | where is zjolnir | raptor vendor location

Zjolnir sells whistle-summoned raptors, the signature racial mounts of the Darkspear trolls. His stock includes various breeds and colors suited for both newly trained riders and experienced veterans.

Can non-trolls buy raptors from him?
Yes, but non-trolls must earn exalted standing with the Darkspear Trolls before Zjolnir will sell to them. Trolls can purchase from him immediately once they possess the required riding skill.

For Darkspear trolls, Zjolnir provides the swift, clawed beasts central to their heritage and fighting traditions.

Zor Lonetree is a knowledgeable orc advisor found within Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar. Well-versed in external affairs and Alliance politics, he aids the Horde by analyzing enemy artifacts and directing travelers to troubled regions across Kalimdor.

Stationed within Grommash Hold alongside the Horde's high leadership, Zor Lonetree serves as a shrewd advisor who keeps a watchful eye on developments beyond Durotar. He possesses an unusually keen understanding of human and Alliance politics, making him an invaluable counselor when foreign curiosities or political threats reach the capital. From inspecting noble jewelry recovered from human settlements to monitoring disturbances among the land's spirits in Stonetalon Mountains, Lonetree ensures the warchief's court stays informed on matters both mundane and mystical.

Zor Lonetree is an orc advisor stationed inside Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar. He is known for his intellect, understanding of Alliance political structures, and interest in Kalimdor's spiritual matters.

What tasks does Zor Lonetree give adventurers?

Zor Lonetree directs Horde champions to assist the spirits of Stonetalon Peak, dispatching travelers to soothe the elemental unrest in the Stonetalon Mountains. He also analyzes strange human relics brought to the capital by scouts.

Unlike many frontline warriors, Zor specializes in foreign affairs and statecraft. He studies human aristocratic customs and Alliance movements, allowing him to decipher noble signets, regalia, and tactical motives that other orcs might overlook.

Zureetha Fargaze is an orc mentor stationed in the Valley of Trials in Durotar alongside Foreman Thazz'ril. Vigilant against corruption, she directs young Horde recruits to investigate and root out the dark influence of the Burning Blade cult hiding within the valley.

While Foreman Thazz'ril oversees the labor and discipline of young orcs and Darkspear trolls, Zureetha Fargaze keeps watch for subtler, more insidious threats. The Burning Blade cult has secretly infiltrated the Valley of Trials, corrupting lesser demons and gathering strength in the nearby cavern of Burning Blade Coven. Zureetha tasks untested adventurers with retrieving medallions from the cultists to confirm their presence and dismantle their early operations before directing seasoned recruits outward into Durotar.
Zureetha Fargaze is an orc questgiver stationed in the Valley of Trials in Durotar. She stands near Foreman Thazz'ril and monitors the hidden threats creeping into the training grounds.

Why is she concerned about the Burning Blade?

The demonic Burning Blade cult has taken root inside a nearby cave, drawing foul familiars and corrupting the peaceful trial grounds. Zureetha seeks proof of their presence through their cultist medallions and sends recruits to thin their numbers.
